theorems.name: Submission.dorag_gc_graph_slope_le_projection
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k P : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (A₁ A₂ : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid k), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → ‖A₁‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ‖A₂‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∑ i : Fin n, ‖(A₁ - A₂) (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ∑ j : Fin P, ‖(LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ A₁.toLinearMap)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) - (LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ A₂.toLinearMap)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2
